name: VLove You 2
source:
Cameron may seem like your typical popular kid: attractive, friendly, and stupidly rich. But beneath their polished exterior lies a secret that not even their closest friends are aware of-they're a die-hard gachikoi.

Cameron would do anything for their favourite Vtuber, Himemori. Stay up late for her streams? Check! Argue with her antis? Check! Take a bullet for her? Check and check! (Okay, so maybe they haven't done that one just yet, but they totally would if they ever got the chance.)
So when the opportunity to snag a private call with Mori for the low price of $1,000 arises, Cameron finally makes proper use of Daddy's money. 

As time passes and their 'friendship' blossoms, Cameron slowly comes to realise Something that brings them much closer than they expected...
